the age of electric.bio: Regina-rooted band The Age of Electric was a Canadian alternative-rock group whose melodic 1990s catalogue helped launch the later careers of members Ryan Dahle, Kurt Dahle and Todd Kerns.

the boomtang boys.bio: Toronto production group The Boomtang Boys is a Canadian dance and electronic act known for remix work and late-1990s pop-dance hits including Squeeze Toy and Movin' On.

the glorious sons.bio: Kingston rock band The Glorious Sons is a Juno-winning Canadian group known for anthemic songwriting, arena-sized performances and a modern take on hard-driving rock and roll.

the moffatts.bio: Canadian sibling band The Moffatts moved from country music into polished pop-rock and teen pop, building a major international following during the 1990s.

the new cities.bio: Trois-Rivières band The New Cities was a Canadian synth-pop and dance-rock group that blended pop-punk guitars with electronic production during the late 2000s and early 2010s.

the new pornographers.bio: Vancouver-formed collective The New Pornographers is a Canadian indie-rock and power-pop group known for dense harmonies, melodic songwriting and members drawn from several acclaimed projects.

the philosopher kings.bio: Thornhill-formed band The Philosopher Kings is a Canadian R&B, pop and rock group whose sophisticated musicianship and songwriting earned national success and a Juno Award in the 1990s.

the sheepdogs.bio: Saskatoon band The Sheepdogs is a Canadian rock group known for warm vocal harmonies, twin-guitar arrangements and a modern revival of 1970s-inspired roots and classic rock.

the tea party.bio: Windsor trio The Tea Party is a Canadian alternative and progressive-rock band known for combining heavy rock with Middle Eastern and global musical influences.

the tenors.bio: The Tenors is a Canadian operatic-pop vocal group known for blending classical repertoire with contemporary pop, rock and folk in a multi-platinum international career.

the trews.bio: Antigonish, Nova Scotia band The Trews is a long-running Canadian rock group known for energetic live shows, melodic guitar rock and a catalogue of national radio staples.

the watchmen.bio: Winnipeg band The Watchmen is a Canadian alternative-rock group that became one of the country's most successful rock acts of the 1990s with a run of platinum and gold albums.

the zolas.bio: Vancouver band The Zolas is a Canadian indie-rock group known for melodic, keyboard-rich alternative pop and a catalogue that has earned national radio play and Juno recognition.

theory of a deadman.bio: Delta, British Columbia band Theory of a Deadman is a Canadian modern-rock group whose sound combines post-grunge, hard rock, acoustic pop and country influences.

three days grace.bio: Norwood, Ontario band Three Days Grace is a Canadian hard-rock and post-grunge group whose emotionally direct songwriting has produced a long run of major rock-radio hits.

tom cochrane.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter Tom Cochrane is a veteran rock artist known for his work with Red Rider and the landmark solo hit Life Is a Highway.

treble charger.bio: Sault Ste. Marie band Treble Charger is a Canadian rock group that evolved from melodic indie rock into pop-punk and alternative-rock radio staples during the late 1990s and early 2000s.
